696	def _deal_dkg_contribution(
697	    sender_id: int,
698	    participant_ids: Iterable[int],
699	    threshold: int,
700	    *,
701	    group_prime: int,
702	    generator: int,
703	    blinding_generator: int,
704	    prime: int = DEFAULT_PRIME,
705	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
706	    constant: int | None = None,
707	):
708	    """Validate a dealing and draw its polynomials and double shares.
709	
710	    Returns ``(ordered_ids, coefficients, blinding_coefficients, shares,
711	    blinding_shares, pedersen_commitment)``; the coefficients stay inside the
712	    package and let :func:`create_signing_contribution` add a Feldman
713	    commitment to the very same sharing polynomial. With ``constant`` set,
714	    the sharing polynomial's constant term is fixed at that value (and is not
715	    drawn from ``randbelow``); the remaining sharing coefficients and every
716	    blinding coefficient follow the usual draw order. This supports the
717	    proactive refresh dealing (a zero constant shifts every share without
718	    changing the joint secret) and the reshare dealing (a Lagrange-weighted
719	    old share as the constant).
720	    """
721	    ordered_ids = _validate_dkg_dealing_parameters(
722	        sender_id,
723	        participant_ids,
724	        threshold,
725	        prime,
726	        group_prime,
727	        generator,
728	        blinding_generator,
729	    )
730	    if constant is None:
731	        coefficients = [randbelow(prime) for _ in range(threshold)]
732	    else:
733	        coefficients = [constant] + [randbelow(prime) for _ in range(threshold - 1)]
734	    blinding_coefficients = [randbelow(prime) for _ in range(threshold)]
735	
736	    shares = tuple(
737	        Share(
738	            x=participant_id,
739	            y=evaluate_polynomial(coefficients, participant_id, prime=prime),
740	        )
741	        for participant_id in ordered_ids
742	    )
743	    blinding_shares = tuple(
744	        Share(
745	            x=participant_id,
746	            y=evaluate_polynomial(blinding_coefficients, participant_id, prime=prime),
747	        )
748	        for participant_id in ordered_ids
749	    )
750	    commitment = PedersenCommitment(
751	        values=tuple(
752	            pow(generator, coefficient, group_prime)
753	            * pow(blinding_generator, blinding, group_prime)
754	            % group_prime
755	            for coefficient, blinding in zip(coefficients, blinding_coefficients)
756	        ),
757	        field_prime=prime,
758	        group_prime=group_prime,
759	        generator=generator,
760	        blinding_generator=blinding_generator,
761	    )
762	    return (
763	        ordered_ids,
764	        coefficients,
765	        blinding_coefficients,
766	        shares,
767	        blinding_shares,
768	        commitment,
769	    )
770

772	def create_dkg_contribution(
773	    sender_id: int,
774	    participant_ids: Iterable[int],
775	    threshold: int,
776	    *,
777	    group_prime: int,
778	    generator: int,
779	    blinding_generator: int,
780	    prime: int = DEFAULT_PRIME,
781	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
782	) -> DKGContribution:
783	    """Create one participant's contribution to a single-round Pedersen DKG.
784	
785	    Every participant runs this once with the same ``participant_ids``,
786	    ``threshold`` and group parameters. The sender draws a random sharing
787	    polynomial and a random blinding polynomial (``threshold`` coefficients
788	    each, all from ``randbelow``; a deterministic source may legitimately
789	    produce an all-zero contribution), commits to both with a Pedersen
790	    commitment, and evaluates a double share for each participant id. Ids
791	    must satisfy ``1 <= id <= prime - 1``, must be unique, and the sender
792	    must be one of the participants. The joint secret is the sum of all
793	    participants' random constant terms, so nobody ever knows it.
794	    """

796	        ordered_ids,
797	        _coefficients,
798	        _blinding_coefficients,
799	        shares,
800	        blinding_shares,
801	        commitment,
802	    ) = _deal_dkg_contribution(
803	        sender_id,
804	        participant_ids,
805	        threshold,
806	        group_prime=group_prime,
807	        generator=generator,
808	        blinding_generator=blinding_generator,
809	        prime=prime,
810	        randbelow=randbelow,
811	    )
812	    return DKGContribution(
813	        sender_id=sender_id,
814	        participant_ids=ordered_ids,
815	        shares=shares,
816	        blinding_shares=blinding_shares,
817	        commitment=commitment,
818	    )

821	def verify_dkg_received_share(
822	    received: DKGReceivedShare, commitment: PedersenCommitment
823	) -> bool:
824	    """Check a received DKG double share against the sender's Pedersen commitment.
825	
826	    Reuses the Pedersen check of :func:`verify_pedersen_share`: a match
827	    returns ``True``; a well-formed share that was tampered with, or whose
828	    coordinates do not name ``receiver_id``, returns ``False``. Illegal ids,
829	    coordinates, values or commitments raise TypeError/ValueError.
830	    """
831	    if not isinstance(received, DKGReceivedShare):
832	        raise TypeError("received must be a DKGReceivedShare instance")
833	    if not isinstance(commitment, PedersenCommitment):
834	        raise TypeError("commitment must be a PedersenCommitment instance")
835	    for name, value in (
836	        ("sender_id", received.sender_id),
837	        ("receiver_id", received.receiver_id),
838	    ):
839	        if not isinstance(value, int):
840	            raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an integer")
841	    if not isinstance(received.share, Share):
842	        raise TypeError("received.share must be a Share instance")
843	    if not isinstance(received.blinding_share, Share):
844	        raise TypeError("received.blinding_share must be a Share instance")
845	    if not isinstance(commitment.field_prime, int):
846	        raise TypeError("field_prime must be an integer")
847	
848	    field_prime = commitment.field_prime
849	    if not 0 < received.sender_id < field_prime:
850	        raise ValueError("sender id must satisfy 1 <= sender_id <= field_prime - 1")
851	    if not 0 < received.receiver_id < field_prime:
852	        raise ValueError("receiver id must satisfy 1 <= receiver_id <= field_prime - 1")
853	
854	    if not verify_pedersen_share(received.share, received.blinding_share, commitment):
855	        return False
856	    # Both coordinates must name the addressed receiver (the Pedersen check
857	    # already pins the two coordinates to each other).
858	    return received.share.x == received.receiver_id

894	def _check_dkg_contribution_structure(contribution: DKGContribution) -> None:
895	    """Validate the ids, lengths and threshold of one contribution (ValueError)."""
896	    ids = contribution.participant_ids
897	    if not ids:
898	        raise ValueError("participant ids must not be empty")
899	    if any(ids[index] >= ids[index + 1] for index in range(len(ids) - 1)):
900	        raise ValueError("participant ids must be strictly increasing and unique")
901	    field_prime = contribution.commitment.field_prime
902	    for participant_id in ids:
903	        if not 0 < participant_id < field_prime:
904	            raise ValueError("participant ids must satisfy 1 <= id <= field_prime - 1")
905	    if contribution.sender_id not in ids:
906	        raise ValueError("sender_id must be one of the participant ids")
907	    if not len(contribution.shares) == len(contribution.blinding_shares) == len(ids):

909	    if not 1 <= len(contribution.commitment.values) <= len(ids):
910	        raise ValueError("threshold must satisfy 1 <= threshold <= participant count")

913	def aggregate_dkg(
914	    contributions: Iterable[DKGContribution],
915	) -> DKGResult | list[DKGRejection]:
916	    """Combine one verified contribution per participant into the joint key material.
917	
918	    Every participant must contribute exactly once, and all contributions
919	    must agree on the participant ids, the threshold and the group
920	    parameters. Missing or duplicate participants, illegal ids or
921	    commitments, and inconsistent parameters raise ValueError; wrong types
922	    raise TypeError. Each double share is verified against its sender's
923	    commitment and failures are never dropped: if any contribution does not
924	    verify, the result is a list of :class:`DKGRejection` naming every
925	    sender whose contribution failed.
926	
927	    On success the double shares of all contributions are added modulo
928	    ``field_prime`` and the commitments are multiplied componentwise modulo
929	    ``group_prime``, so the input order does not affect the result. Any
930	    ``threshold`` receivers can rebuild the joint secret from their
931	    aggregated shares with :func:`reconstruct_secret`, yet no single party
932	    ever learns it.
933	    """
934	    materialised = list(contributions)
935	    if not materialised:
936	        raise ValueError("at least one contribution is required")
937	    for contribution in materialised:
938	        if not isinstance(contribution, DKGContribution):
939	            raise TypeError("contributions must be DKGContribution instances")
940	        _check_dkg_contribution_types(contribution)
941	
942	    first = materialised[0]
943	    participant_ids = first.participant_ids
944	    first_commitment = first.commitment
945	    threshold = len(first_commitment.values)
946	    for contribution in materialised:
947	        _check_dkg_contribution_structure(contribution)
948	        commitment = contribution.commitment
949	        if contribution.participant_ids != participant_ids:
950	            raise ValueError("contributions must agree on the same participant ids")
951	        if (
952	            commitment.field_prime != first_commitment.field_prime
953	            or commitment.group_prime != first_commitment.group_prime
954	            or commitment.generator != first_commitment.generator
955	            or commitment.blinding_generator != first_commitment.blinding_generator
956	        ):
957	            raise ValueError("contributions must share the same group parameters")
958	        if len(commitment.values) != threshold:
959	            raise ValueError("contributions must share the same threshold")
960	
961	    sender_ids = [contribution.sender_id for contribution in materialised]
962	    if len(set(sender_ids)) != len(sender_ids):
963	        raise ValueError("duplicate contribution from the same participant")
964	    if set(sender_ids) != set(participant_ids):
965	        raise ValueError("each participant must contribute exactly once")
966	
967	    # Sort by sender so the input order cannot influence the outcome.
968	    ordered = sorted(materialised, key=lambda contribution: contribution.sender_id)
969	
970	    rejections = []
971	    for contribution in ordered:
972	        for index, receiver_id in enumerate(contribution.participant_ids):
973	            received = DKGReceivedShare(
974	                sender_id=contribution.sender_id,
975	                receiver_id=receiver_id,
976	                share=contribution.shares[index],
977	                blinding_share=contribution.blinding_shares[index],
978	            )
979	            if not verify_dkg_received_share(received, contribution.commitment):
980	                rejections.append(DKGRejection(sender_id=contribution.sender_id))
981	                break
982	    if rejections:
983	        return rejections
984	
985	    field_prime = first_commitment.field_prime
986	    group_prime = first_commitment.group_prime
987	    shares = []
988	    blinding_shares = []
989	    for index, receiver_id in enumerate(participant_ids):
990	        y = 0
991	        y_blinding = 0
992	        for contribution in ordered:
993	            y = (y + contribution.shares[index].y) % field_prime
994	            y_blinding = (y_blinding + contribution.blinding_shares[index].y) % field_prime
995	        shares.append(Share(x=receiver_id, y=y))
996	        blinding_shares.append(Share(x=receiver_id, y=y_blinding))
997	    joint_values = []
998	    for position in range(threshold):
999	        value = 1
1000	        for contribution in ordered:
1001	            value = value * contribution.commitment.values[position] % group_prime
1002	        joint_values.append(value)
1003	    return DKGResult(
1004	        participant_ids=participant_ids,
1005	        shares=tuple(shares),
1006	        blinding_shares=tuple(blinding_shares),
1007	        commitment=PedersenCommitment(
1008	            values=tuple(joint_values),
1009	            field_prime=field_prime,
1010	            group_prime=group_prime,
1011	            generator=first_commitment.generator,
1012	            blinding_generator=first_commitment.blinding_generator,
1013	        ),
1014	    )
1015

1231	def aggregate_signing_dkg(
1232	    contributions: Iterable[SigningContribution],
1233	) -> SigningDKGResult | list[DKGRejection]:
1234	    """Aggregate signing contributions into the joint key and verification shares.
1235	
1236	    Every participant must contribute exactly once with agreeing ids,
1237	    threshold and group parameters; the plain-DKG checks of
1238	    :func:`aggregate_dkg` apply unchanged and each nested contribution's
1239	    double shares are verified against its Pedersen commitment. Failures
1240	    are never dropped: the result is a sender-sorted ``list`` of
1241	    :class:`DKGRejection` naming every contribution that failed its Pedersen
1242	    verification (a malformed or unbound Feldman commitment is an illegal
1243	    input and raises ValueError instead).
1244	
1245	    On success returns a :class:`SigningDKGResult`: the unchanged
1246	    :class:`DKGResult`, the joint public key
1247	    ``Y = product of the contributions' constant-term Feldman commitments``
1248	    and one verification share ``Y_i`` per participant, each the product of
1249	    every contribution's Feldman evaluation at ``i``.
1250	    """
1251	    materialised = list(contributions)
1252	    if not materialised:
1253	        raise ValueError("at least one contribution is required")
1254	    for contribution in materialised:
1255	        _check_signing_contribution_types(contribution)
1256	    for contribution in materialised:
1257	        _check_signing_contribution_structure(contribution)
1258	
1259	    dealings = [contribution.contribution for contribution in materialised]
1260	
1261	    # Structural consistency (ids, threshold, group parameters, exactly one
1262	    # contribution per participant) is the plain DKG aggregation's job.
1263	    first = dealings[0]
1264	    participant_ids = first.participant_ids
1265	    first_pedersen = first.commitment
1266	    threshold = len(first_pedersen.values)
1267	    for dealing in dealings:
1268	        commitment = dealing.commitment
1269	        if dealing.participant_ids != participant_ids:
1270	            raise ValueError("contributions must agree on the same participant ids")
1271	        if (
1272	            commitment.field_prime != first_pedersen.field_prime
1273	            or commitment.group_prime != first_pedersen.group_prime
1274	            or commitment.generator != first_pedersen.generator
1275	            or commitment.blinding_generator != first_pedersen.blinding_generator
1276	        ):
1277	            raise ValueError("contributions must share the same group parameters")
1278	        if len(commitment.values) != threshold:
1279	            raise ValueError("contributions must share the same threshold")
1280	    sender_ids = [dealing.sender_id for dealing in dealings]
1281	    if len(set(sender_ids)) != len(sender_ids):
1282	        raise ValueError("duplicate contribution from the same participant")
1283	    if set(sender_ids) != set(participant_ids):
1284	        raise ValueError("each participant must contribute exactly once")
1285	
1286	    ordered = sorted(materialised, key=lambda item: item.contribution.sender_id)
1287	
1288	    rejections: list[DKGRejection] = []
1289	    for item in ordered:
1290	        dealing = item.contribution
1291	        for index, receiver_id in enumerate(dealing.participant_ids):
1292	            received = DKGReceivedShare(
1293	                sender_id=dealing.sender_id,
1294	                receiver_id=receiver_id,
1295	                share=dealing.shares[index],
1296	                blinding_share=dealing.blinding_shares[index],
1297	            )
1298	            if not verify_dkg_received_share(received, dealing.commitment):
1299	                rejections.append(DKGRejection(sender_id=dealing.sender_id))
1300	                break
1301	    if rejections:
1302	        return rejections
1303	
1304	    # Every surviving double share is Pedersen-valid; the Feldman commitment
1305	    # must additionally evaluate on the same sharing polynomial. A mismatch
1306	    # here is an internally inconsistent contribution (legal pieces, wrong
1307	    # pairing), reported as an illegal input rather than a rejection.
1308	    for item in ordered:
1309	        for share in item.contribution.shares:
1310	            if not verify_share(share, item.feldman_commitment):
1311	                raise ValueError(
1312	                    "Feldman commitment must match the contribution shares"
1313	                )
1314	
1315	    result = aggregate_dkg([item.contribution for item in ordered])
1316	    assert isinstance(result, DKGResult)
1317	
1318	    group_prime = first_pedersen.group_prime
1319	    public_key = 1
1320	    verification_shares: list[int] = [1 for _ in participant_ids]
1321	    for item in ordered:
1322	        feldman = item.feldman_commitment
1323	        public_key = public_key * feldman.values[0] % group_prime
1324	        for index, receiver_id in enumerate(participant_ids):
1325	            x_power = 1
1326	            evaluation = 1
1327	            for value in feldman.values:
1328	                evaluation = evaluation * pow(value, x_power, group_prime) % group_prime
1329	                x_power = x_power * receiver_id % feldman.field_prime
1330	            verification_shares[index] = (
1331	                verification_shares[index] * evaluation % group_prime
1332	            )
1333	    return SigningDKGResult(
1334	        result=result,
1335	        public_key=public_key,
1336	        verification_shares=tuple(verification_shares),
1337	    )

1341	    contributions: Iterable[SigningContribution],
1342	    key: SigningDKGResult,
1343	) -> SigningDKGResult | list[DKGRejection]:
1344	    """Proactively refresh the shares of ``key`` with zero-secret contributions.
1345	
1346	    Every participant of ``key`` must contribute exactly once with the same
1347	    participant ids, threshold and group parameters; the plain-DKG structural
1348	    checks of :func:`aggregate_signing_dkg` apply unchanged and each nested
1349	    contribution's double shares are verified against its Pedersen
1350	    commitment. Beyond those checks, every contribution's Feldman constant-
1351	    term commitment must be ``1`` (proving a zero sharing constant term) and
1352	    its double shares must lie on the polynomial committed to by both its
1353	    commitments. A contribution that fails any of these cryptographic checks
1354	    is named in a sender-sorted ``list`` of :class:`DKGRejection`; malformed
1355	    arguments, missing/duplicate participants or inconsistent parameters
1356	    raise TypeError/ValueError as in :func:`aggregate_signing_dkg`.
1357	
1358	    On success the double shares are added fieldwise to ``key``'s and both
1359	    commitment families are multiplied groupwise, so the joint secret and the
1360	    public key are unchanged (every contribution's Feldman constant
1361	    commitment is 1) while ``verification_shares`` are recomputed from the new
1362	    aggregated shares. The result is independent of the input order. The
1363	    library keeps no state: the caller must destroy the old shares and adopt
1364	    the returned ones, and signatures made under the old key remain valid.
1365	    """
1366	    if not isinstance(key, SigningDKGResult):
1367	        raise TypeError("key must be a SigningDKGResult instance")
1368	    _check_signing_setup(key)
1369	    _check_signing_dkg_structure(key)
1370	
1371	    materialised = list(contributions)
1372	    if not materialised:
1373	        raise ValueError("at least one contribution is required")
1374	    for contribution in materialised:
1375	        _check_signing_contribution_types(contribution)
1376	    for contribution in materialised:
1377	        _check_signing_contribution_structure(contribution)
1378	
1379	    old_result = key.result
1380	    old_pedersen = old_result.commitment
1381	    participant_ids = old_result.participant_ids
1382	    threshold = len(old_pedersen.values)
1383	    dealings = [contribution.contribution for contribution in materialised]
1384	    for dealing in dealings:
1385	        commitment = dealing.commitment
1386	        if dealing.participant_ids != participant_ids:
1387	            raise ValueError("contributions must agree on the same participant ids")
1388	        if (
1389	            commitment.field_prime != old_pedersen.field_prime
1390	            or commitment.group_prime != old_pedersen.group_prime
1391	            or commitment.generator != old_pedersen.generator
1392	            or commitment.blinding_generator != old_pedersen.blinding_generator
1393	        ):
1394	            raise ValueError("contributions must share the same group parameters")
1395	        if len(commitment.values) != threshold:
1396	            raise ValueError("contributions must share the same threshold")
1397	    sender_ids = [dealing.sender_id for dealing in dealings]
1398	    if len(set(sender_ids)) != len(sender_ids):
1399	        raise ValueError("duplicate contribution from the same participant")
1400	    if set(sender_ids) != set(participant_ids):
1401	        raise ValueError("each participant must contribute exactly once")
1402	
1403	    ordered = sorted(materialised, key=lambda item: item.contribution.sender_id)
1404	
1405	    rejections: list[DKGRejection] = []
1406	    for item in ordered:
1407	        dealing = item.contribution
1408	        failed = False
1409	        for index, receiver_id in enumerate(dealing.participant_ids):
1410	            received = DKGReceivedShare(
1411	                sender_id=dealing.sender_id,
1412	                receiver_id=receiver_id,
1413	                share=dealing.shares[index],
1414	                blinding_share=dealing.blinding_shares[index],
1415	            )
1416	            if not verify_dkg_received_share(received, dealing.commitment):
1417	                failed = True
1418	                break
1419	            if not verify_share(dealing.shares[index], item.feldman_commitment):
1420	                failed = True
1421	                break

1424	    if rejections:
1425	        return rejections

1427	    field_prime = old_pedersen.field_prime
1428	    group_prime = old_pedersen.group_prime
1429	    new_shares = []
1430	    new_blinding_shares = []
1431	    for index, receiver_id in enumerate(participant_ids):
1432	        y = old_result.shares[index].y
1433	        y_blinding = old_result.blinding_shares[index].y
1434	        for item in ordered:
1435	            y = (y + item.contribution.shares[index].y) % field_prime
1436	            y_blinding = (
1437	                y_blinding + item.contribution.blinding_shares[index].y
1438	            ) % field_prime

1475	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1476	# Member resharing: a threshold quorum of old participants re-deals the joint
1477	# secret to a (possibly different) member set under an arbitrary new
1478	# threshold. Each dealer shares its Lagrange-weighted old share, so the new
1479	# shares rebuild the very same joint secret and the public key is unchanged.
1480	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1481	
1482	
1483	def _check_reshare_dealers(
1484	    dealers: Iterable[int],
1485	    participant_ids: tuple[int, ...],
1486	    old_threshold: int,
1487	    members: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
1488	) -> list[int]:
1489	    """Validate the dealer set of a resharing, returning it as a list.
1490	
1491	    Dealers must be strictly increasing, unique, number at least the old
1492	    threshold, and every dealer must be a participant of the old key; with
1493	    ``members`` given, every dealer must also be one of the new members (the
1494	    dealer both holds an old share and receives a new one).
1495	    """
1496	    if isinstance(dealers, (str, bytes)):
1497	        raise TypeError("dealers must be an iterable of integers")
1498	    dealer_list = list(dealers)
1499	    for dealer in dealer_list:
1500	        if not isinstance(dealer, int) or isinstance(dealer, bool):
1501	            raise TypeError("dealer ids must be integers")
1502	    if not dealer_list:
1503	        raise ValueError("at least one dealer is required")
1504	    if len(set(dealer_list)) != len(dealer_list):
1505	        raise ValueError("dealer ids must be unique")
1506	    if dealer_list != sorted(dealer_list):
1507	        raise ValueError("dealer ids must be strictly increasing")
1508	    if len(dealer_list) < old_threshold:
1509	        raise ValueError("dealers must number at least the old threshold")
1510	    for dealer in dealer_list:
1511	        if dealer not in participant_ids:
1512	            raise ValueError("every dealer must be a participant of the old key")
1513	    if members is not None:
1514	        for dealer in dealer_list:
1515	            if dealer not in members:
1516	                raise ValueError("every dealer must be one of the new members")
1517	    return dealer_list
1518

1520	def create_reshare(
1521	    sender: int,
1522	    share: int,
1523	    dealers: Iterable[int],
1524	    members: Iterable[int],
1525	    threshold: int,
1526	    key: SigningDKGResult,
1527	    *,
1528	    rng: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
1529	) -> SigningContribution:
1530	    """Create one dealer's contribution to a member resharing of ``key``.
1531	
1532	    ``sender`` is one of the old participants; ``share`` is its aggregated
1533	    secret share ``s_i`` of ``key`` (checked against the old verification
1534	    share ``Y_i``, a mismatch raises ValueError). ``dealers`` is the strictly
1535	    increasing, duplicate-free quorum of old participants re-dealing the
1536	    secret: it must number at least the old threshold and every dealer must
1537	    be a participant of ``key`` and one of the new ``members``. ``members``
1538	    is the new participant-id set and ``threshold`` the new threshold ``t``;
1539	    both follow the usual DKG dealing constraints.
1540	
1541	    The sender's new sharing polynomial over ``members`` has the constant
1542	    term ``lambda_i * share mod q`` (not drawn), where ``lambda_i`` is the
1543	    sender's Lagrange weight at zero over ``dealers``; then ``t - 1`` sharing
1544	    coefficients and ``t`` blinding coefficients are drawn from ``rng(q)`` in
1545	    exactly the order of :func:`create_signing_contribution`. Summing one
1546	    such contribution per dealer makes the new constant terms add up to
1547	    ``sum(lambda_i * s_i)`` — the old joint secret — so any ``t`` new members
1548	    rebuild it while the public key stays unchanged.
1549	    """
1550	    if not isinstance(key, SigningDKGResult):
1551	        raise TypeError("key must be a SigningDKGResult instance")
1552	    _check_signing_setup(key)
1553	    _check_signing_dkg_structure(key)
1554	    if not isinstance(sender, int) or isinstance(sender, bool):
1555	        raise TypeError("sender must be an integer")
1556	    if not isinstance(share, int) or isinstance(share, bool):
1557	        raise TypeError("share must be an integer")
1558	
1559	    old_result = key.result
1560	    pedersen = old_result.commitment
1561	    field_prime = pedersen.field_prime
1562	    group_prime = pedersen.group_prime
1563	    generator = pedersen.generator
1564	    old_ids = old_result.participant_ids
1565	    old_threshold = len(pedersen.values)
1566	
1567	    ordered_members = _validate_dkg_dealing_parameters(
1568	        sender,
1569	        members,
1570	        threshold,
1571	        field_prime,
1572	        group_prime,
1573	        generator,
1574	        pedersen.blinding_generator,
1575	    )
1576	    dealer_list = _check_reshare_dealers(
1577	        dealers, old_ids, old_threshold, ordered_members
1578	    )
1579	    if sender not in dealer_list:
1580	        raise ValueError("sender must be one of the dealers")
1581	
1582	    if not 0 <= share < field_prime:
1583	        raise ValueError("share must satisfy 0 <= share < field_prime")
1584	    sender_index = old_ids.index(sender)
1585	    if pow(generator, share, group_prime) != key.verification_shares[sender_index]:
1586	        raise ValueError("share does not match the old verification share Y_i")
